missing: Measured tests of cooled vs uncooled Qi2 mounts while navigating in a hot car: phone temperature over time, how much charge is actually delivered, and whether charging stops. Also which car adapter each mount needs, and the cost including that adapter.
why: No major reviewer or authority answers this with its own testing. Wired, the only big name, mentions a cooled ESR mount in one line of a general car mount guide. Anker's page is a brand blog. The pages that do answer are niche sites and affiliate roundups (Dash & Drive, MobilePlus, The Gadgeteer, carcody, RBE), and they rely on maker specs and opinion, with no temperature or charging data. They also disagree on the pick: ESR, UGREEN, LISEN or Anker. A focused page that tests cooled Qi2 and Qi2.2 mounts during navigation, with current prices including the adapter, would stand out.
